Name: Ducki's Updated Farmhouse
Author: quackeeduck
Description:
I hated grandpa's house, so I made you all this. Should be compatible with every mod except those that replace the Farmhouse file.

Works with all furniture, flooring, and wallpaper!

Possible updates include:
- Remade 2nd house upgrade
- Toggleable kitchen for first farmhouse (currently doesn't include one)

Just drag and drop into your mods file, and it should be good to go!

Mods on my farmer:
https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14695 by oddpine
https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7732 by GoblinHours
